rows.en: As we return to Earth, HQ has handed down official orders.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We<pt(0,-18.75,0,2)> will join a UCE-led operation to retake <pic(0)><cs(3)>Jaburo<ce()>, a military base in South America.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: <mk(-25,0,5,1,50)><mk(-25,-37.5,7,1,100)><mk(25,0,3,1,150)><mk(25,-37.5,1,1,200)>Jaburo was the UCE military HQ, but the Titans have held it since they broke away.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: No surprise. It was used by the Titans, once the core of the <cs(1)>Earth Federation Forces<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The fires of war have not yet gone out on the surface. Do not let your guard down.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The recapture operation succeeded, and Jaburo once again belongs to our UCE.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: Jaburo will now be fully refitted and used as a UCE military stronghold.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: The E2 you brought back will also be stored here.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: The victory of our UCE is beyond doubt. But enemies still remain on the surface.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: From now on, you will serve as a strike force on the surface.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: I expect you to sweep away the evil on Earth and help establish order.
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: Just what do you think you are doing? Is that all the strength you have?
rows.speaker: UCE official?

rows.en: The future of Earth rests on your shoulders. This will not do. Pull yourselves together.
rows.speaker: UCE official?
